items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE
items.summary: A maximum-severity vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) in Magento and Adobe Commerce allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary PHP code on store servers. Adobe released a fix in APSB26-153 on October 13, 2026, but it requires a manual patch, and new installations remain vulnerable.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a critical security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, addressing issues including the BlockStrap vulnerability (CVE-2026-103849). Merchants are advised to apply the latest security updates as soon as possible, noting that a hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 is not included and must be applied separately.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a zero-day vulnerability in Magento and Adobe Commerce that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution, with attacks observed starting September 4, 2026. Adobe later released a security update (APSB26-146) to resolve this vulnerability.

items.title: Urgent Action Required Critical Security Update Available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe became aware of a zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) in Adobe Commerce and released a security update (APSB26-146) to resolve it. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on an affected installation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover
items.summary: Adobe released APSB26-92, an update that fixes seven vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1. This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, with successful exploitation potentially leading to security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Adobe Security Bulletin APSB25-71
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, addressing critical and important vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.
